<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli.mjs from `skillpouch --help`. Do not edit; run `pnpm --filter @skillpouch/docs gen:cli`. -->

Show the account and device this computer is connected to.

Exits with code `3` when this computer is not logged in.

## Usage

```sh
skillpouch status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option   | What it does                 |
| -------- | ---------------------------- |
| `--json` | Print machine-readable JSON. |
